newsitem.title: UK: Copper edges up in LME evening, zinc guards gains.
newsitem.headline: Copper edges up in LME evening, zinc guards gains.

text.p: Copper prices inched back towards earlier highs during Wednesday evening LME inter-office trading, while the bouyant zinc market stayed close to 23-month peaks.

Traders said copper activity was less intense today, as speculative money moved into other metals, such as zinc, nickel and lead. Aluminium, although steadier, was also comparatively subdued and did not notch up significant gains.
Copper remained shy of testing the $2,280 level during the evening, and was indicated at $2,270/2,274 a tonne at 1900 gmt. Aluminium was quoted at $1,613/1,615.

Zinc, which hit a high of $1,132 per tonne, the strongest since February, was standing at $1,123/1,126, or close to the technically important $1,123/4 area, the top of a two-year sideways trading range.
